LanguageData.IDL_Settings_LootAmountTooltip: Higher values produce more loot rolls and therefore more profit. Lower values produce fewer rolls and less profit. Values below 1x use a proportional chance for a roll to produce no loot.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_ItemAmountTooltip: Higher values increase the number of items produced by each successful loot roll. Lower values reduce the item count and expected profit.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_SearchDurationTooltip: Higher values make dungeon searches take longer. Lower values shorten searches and increase the potential profit per unit of time.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_InfestationsEnabledTooltip: Allows dungeon entrances to trigger RimWorld's deep-drill infestation event. This is enabled by default. Disabling it prevents dungeon entrances from causing insect infestations.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_InfestationChanceTooltip: Scales the existing RimWorld infestation chance for dungeon entrances. 100% preserves the original chance, 50% halves it, and 0% prevents dungeon entrances from causing infestations. This is not a guaranteed chance per scavenging job.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_AllowDuplicates: Allow duplicate items in one loot result
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_AllowDuplicatesTooltip: When enabled, the same item type can be selected more than once during a single loot result. Disable this for more varied loot.
LanguageData.IDL_Settings_CategoryTooltip: Higher values increase loot and expected profit for this category. Lower values reduce both. Setting this to 0x disables loot from the category.
